task: What is the raw memory of a 100.2" * 123.5" true colour picture at 72 ppi?
answer:
FINAL: Approximately 192 MB of raw memory (24-bit true colour).
WolframAlpha shows 100.2 in × 123.5 in at 72 dpi, 64.15 megapixels, and “raw memory | 192 MB (megabytes) (24-bit)”. Evidence screenshot: final.png.
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=100.2+inch+by+123.5+inch+72+dpi+true+color+image
The Computer Science Field Guide confirms that true colour uses 24 bits per pixel: https://www.csfieldguide.org.nz/en/chapters/data-representation/images-and-colours/
